label: D1 after unrewarded a1->S1, larger when the trial before was rewarded
terms: (phase == D1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) != 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -3) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * value ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (tv("action", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (trial == 0) * (in_rew == 0)
explanation: Fires only at D1, almost only after the previous trial was a1 -> S1 unrewarded (about +1.15 over timing; zero at GO/D2, about 0.1 below timing after every other pattern). Within those a1 S1 u trials, the size is set by the earlier history. It is near 2.4 when the trial before (t-2) was rewarded, and further raised by t-3 also rewarded, by t-2 also being an a1 choice, and by higher model value. It is near 0 to 0.4 after a run of omissions (t-2 unrewarded). So it signals a surprising omission at S1 after a1 choices that had been paying off. The window first-trial term only covers D1 steps where the previous trial lies outside the window (in_rew == 0). Future, hidden good-state and since-reversal cues add nothing. The single a1 S1 u indicator gives dev R^2 0.52 beyond timing; the full 7 terms give dev 0.75 and test 0.74, above the additive all ceiling of 0.60. Small leftover: a slight rise after a2 S1 u.

issues: The magnitude is overstated. Fitting a1 S1 u split by the t-2 and t-3 rewards on the test split gives weights over the D1 baseline of about +1.94 when both were rewarded, +1.24 when t-2 was rewarded and t-3 was not, +0.43 when t-2 was unrewarded and t-3 rewarded, and +0.08 when both were unrewarded. The level is about 2.0 even when t-2 and t-3 were both rewarded, and about 1.7 on average when t-2 was rewarded. So 'about 2.4 when t-2 was rewarded' is too high. Only the individual top examples reach 2.3 to 2.5. The '0 to 0.4 after omissions' part checks out.

Most of the worst-fit windows are D1 on the window's first trial (trial == 0, in_rew == 0). The actual value is either 0 or about 2.5, and the model predicts about 0.26 because the previous trial is outside the window. This class is systematic but cannot be fixed with the window's variables. Using the future choice (action == 2) on trial 0 adds only 0.011 test R^2 (0.742 -> 0.753), and using value or choice adds about 0.003. The explanation mentions this term but does not say it is the main remaining error.

'The future cues add nothing' is nearly true but not exactly. Adding last_is('a1 S1 u') * (action == 2) to the terms without value gains about 0.015 test R^2 (0.716 -> 0.730), with a negative weight: the feature is lower before a switch to a2. That is still less than the value term, which adds about 0.027. Good state and since_rev add 0.000 to 0.002.

The other claims check out. GO and D2 are exactly 0. After other previous-trial patterns the residual is about -0.095. An a1 choice at t-2 raises the level (weight 1.71 for a1 vs 1.02 for a2 when t-2 was rewarded). The value term weight is positive (+0.24). The a2 S1 u leftover is small (+0.086 under-prediction in misses). The reported test R^2 of 0.742 reproduces. Small extra history terms (t-2 at S1 and rewarded, a2 S1 u with t-2 rewarded) each add 0.003 or less, so no large observable gap remains.
